description: This file defines a configuration class for XAI's Responses API, extending OpenAIResponsesAPIConfig. It includes methods for parameter support, mapping, environment validation, and URL construction specific to XAI's API.

classes.name: XAIResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for XAI's Responses API, extending the OpenAIResponsesAPIConfig with XAI-specific behavior.

methods.name: custom_llm_provider
methods.description: Returns the LlmProviders.XAI enum indicating the provider type.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters, excluding 'instructions'.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Transforms and maps parameters for XAI API, removing unsupported 'instructions', transforming 'code_interpreter' tools, and setting 'store=false' for images.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up headers with the XAI API key from environment or parameters.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the XAI /responses API endpoint based on base URL and environment variables.
